params.body:
> **Rebased on current `main` (after PR 346).** Supersedes #347, which conflicted on `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`. The finding is renumbered **X-124 → X-125** (346 took X-124), and the one reference in `StylesheetSyntaxTest` follows. Rules R P1-1.15 and R S5-3.9 are unchanged and still free on main. This is **PR A, the base of a three-PR stack** (A: this one, B: relation picker, C: mail logo and address); merge this first.

## What this is

Seven reports came in tonight about the same two screens. They are one defect: **the Stocklist screens only ever had one size, and that was the wide one.** A dealer holding a phone could not read what was on it and could not fill it in. This is the missing half of a layout, not a redesign: nothing above 768px changes.

## Measured, at 390px and at 1440px

Measured in a headless Chromium against the real stylesheet layers in the order `layouts/app.blade.php` loads them (the bought theme, `refresh.css`, `app.scss`, `tailwind.css`), with the markup taken from the views themselves.

| | before @390 | after @390 | @1440 (before = after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| sort control `.ui-select` | **14px**, h 42 | **16px**, h 44 | 13px, h 38 |
| brand/model filter `.ui-select` | **13px**, h 38 | **16px**, h 44 | 13px, h 38 |
| vehicle sheet `.ui-input` | **14px**, h 38 | **16px**, h 44 | 14px, h 38 |
| `select.ui-input` | **14px**, h 38 | **16px**, h 44 | 14px, h 38 |
| relation field (offer modal) | **14px**, h 38 | **16px**, h 44 | 14px, h 38 |
| extras: article field | 13px, w **159.8** | 16px, w **304.0** | 13px, w 531.8 |
| extras: quantity | 13px, w **31.5** | 16px, w **127.2** | 13px, w 121.0 |
| extras: price | 13px, w **34.3** | 16px, w **91.1** | 13px, w 206.4 |
| FlexLease result sentence | **50.4px** (3 lines) | **16.8px** (1 line) | 16.8px |
| the two warranty selects | **18.8px** apart | aligned / stacked | **0.0px** (was 18.8) |
| buy-over amount `€12 500,00` | **2 lines** | **1 line** | 1 line |
| hint under "Overkopen" | 12px, #98a2b3 | 14px, #475467 | same |

Contrast, computed against the panel actually behind the text:

| token | on white | on the mobile actions panel (#f3f3f4) |
|---|---|---|
| `brand-faint` #98a2b3 | **2.58:1** | **2.32:1** |
| `brand-gray` #475467 | 7.69:1 | 6.93:1 |

WCAG AA asks 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 even for large text. `brand-faint` fails both. That is a fact, not a preference.

## Why 16px, and not 14

Two reasons, and the second is the one that moves the page.

1. A native `<select>`'s option list inherits the font size of its control. A 13px control opens a 13px list, and that list is an operating-system window no stylesheet reaches. That is the popup Shane photographed. (The screenshots below show the *control* and state its measured size: a headless browser does not paint that OS window, so no screenshot of the popup itself is claimed.)
2. **iOS zooms the whole document in when a focused form control is under 16px.** So a small field does not merely read small: the layout shifts under the thumb that just tapped it.

## Scope, and why

**Every control in the `ui-` namespace**, not only `ui-select`. The iOS rule applies to any focusable control, so fixing the one Shane photographed would leave the same defect on every other screen and guarantee the next report. One rule in one narrow-screen block, plus the four selectors whose `:nth-child`/compound specificity would otherwise beat it. `resources/css/refresh.css` already carried this exact rule for the vehicle sheet's text boxes (with the iOS reason written out); this generalises it instead of adding a second one.

**Hit area.** The base `.ui-input`/`.ui-select` is 38px tall and the extras fields 34px, both under the ~44px a thumb wants. Raised to 44px inside the narrow-screen block only, so the desktop keeps its 38px and 34px rows.

**Amounts: not in the formatter.** `Custom::formatNumber` uses a plain space as the thousands separator, and the obvious general fix is a non-breaking space there. It is the wrong fix here for two reasons: that string also feeds the TCPDF documents, and the customer-mode price-leak tests assert on its exact spelling — `assertDontSee('12 345,00')` would quietly become vacuous, which is the opposite of what that test is for. Instead one class, `.ui-amount { white-space: nowrap }`, wraps the amount where it is spliced into a sentence.

## Screens affected

Fixed:

- **Stocklist browser** — the sort control, and the filter panel's selects and inputs.
- **Vehicle sheet** (own stock) — every field, select and text box.
- **Offer modal and order modal** — the extras rows and the FlexLease rows stack below 768px; the FlexLease row carries its column header as a label per control, because on a phone that header is off screen.
- **Vehicle detail (buybox)** — the hint under "Overkopen"; the buy-over confirmation amount.
- **RealGarant block** — the two labels of unequal height no longer shift their own selects.
- **Bid box** — the two field labels.
- **Car-Pass confirmation, showroom sheet** — `120 000 km` is one token.
- **`.ui-field-help`** — the hint register under a form field, application-wide: colour only, size unchanged.

The warranty fix holds for the longest translation (`de: Erweiterte Garantie RG`, `fr: Garantie prolongée RG`) because nothing in it depends on the label's height: the items anchor at the end of the row, and where `subgrid` exists the label areas share one height so the labels stay top-aligned too.

## Listed, not fixed

- **`text-brand-faint` as an eyebrow label** (`text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide`) — "Bod vanaf", "Biedingsaanbod", "Biedingen". Same 2.58:1, but it is a documented design register across many screens; changing it is a design decision, not a size change.
- **`text-brand-faint` on `<dt>` spec labels** — vehicle specs, dates, the public website detail. Same defect, same argument: a register across several tables.
- **`text-brand-faint` on icons, placeholders, disabled states and the 404 numeral** — correct as it is; that token is fine for an icon and wrong for a sentence.
- **The extras fields are labelled by their placeholders**, which stop being truncated once the row stacks. Real labels would be a markup change in two modals and a design decision about a label that stays visible while typing.
- **The offers table filter row** (`livewire/offers.blade.php`) — a weaker case; it is a filter, not a form a dealer fills in, and it was not reported.

## Left out of this PR on purpose: the image editor

Shane's seventh report — no reachable save button in the photo editor on a phone — is **not** the same root cause, so it is not fixed here. Diagnosed from source:

- The modal shell is **not** the problem: `.iframe-dialog` is already `max-width: 90vw; height: 90vh` (`resources/sass/vehicle/_edit_image_modal.scss`), so it fits a phone.
- `editImageModal.blade.php` sets the editor to `100vw` below 800px (`factor = '100vw'`, then `.tui-image-editor` width `calc(w * 100vw)`) **inside that 90vw dialog**, and `#tui-image-editor` to `height: 100vh !important` inside a 90vh dialog. The content is deliberately made wider and taller than its container, which is what forces the horizontal scroll.
- The Save button is appended to `.tui-image-editor-header-buttons`, which the vendor stylesheet pins to the right edge of that overflowing header — hence off screen.

So it is **both**: the page's own JavaScript oversizes the editor, and the third-party editor's bottom menu bar is a fixed-width row that does not reflow. Fixing it honestly needs the real editor, a real image and an authenticated route to screenshot before and after, which this PR cannot verify. It deserves its own PR.

The XML import and the other `custom.loadIFrame` modals share the same shell but not the same problem: none of them oversizes its own content.

## Screenshots

Harness pages rendering the real stylesheet layers, Chromium, deviceScaleFactor 2.

- 390px, before: `scratchpad/shots/legible-before-390.png`
- 390px, after: `scratchpad/shots/legible-after-390.png`
- 1440px, before: `scratchpad/shots/legible-before-1440.png`
- 1440px, after: `scratchpad/shots/legible-after-1440.png`
- the sort control alone at 390px: `scratchpad/shots/legible-sort-before-390.png`, `legible-sort-after-390.png`
- the offer modal rows at 390px: `scratchpad/shots/legible-modal-before-390.png`, `legible-modal-after-390.png`

## Docs and tests

- New screen rules **R P1-1.15** (the daily screens) and **R S5-3.9** (the shared stock and its two modals).
- Finding **X-125** in `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`, with the measurements above.
- `StylesheetSyntaxTest::test_a_form_control_is_at_least_16px_on_a_narrow_screen`, tagged `@rule P1-1.15` and `@rule S5-3.9`: no rule inside a `max-width <= 900px` block may set a form control below 16px, and `.ui-amount` must set `white-space: nowrap`. Both halves verified to bite by mutation (putting 14px back, and `nowrap` -> `normal`, each fails).
- `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` and `92-testdekking-tabel.md` are generated and gitignored; not touched, and `git status` was checked before committing.

## Tests

`vendor/bin/phpunit`: **847 tests, 3759 assertions, 1 failure, 1 skipped** — the failure is `BuildStampTest`, the known worktree artifact. The named filter (`StocklistBrowser|OwnStockList|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage`) is **23 tests, 667 assertions, OK**.
params.title: Selects and inputs are legible on a phone (rebased)
